scope: Independent local upgrade-protection review, no external model invocation

expectations.text: Review does not write its baseline, installed or staged candidate inputs.
expectations.evidence: Reviewed all review-update.mjs filesystem calls; independent before/after snapshots of all three synthetic package inputs had identical SHA256 and exact POSIX mode values.

expectations.text: Local additions, modifications and removals are distinguished from proposed changes.
expectations.evidence: Existing tests 11 and 12 actually compare local-notes.txt addition, removed host-compatibility.md, and proposed SKILL.md byte changes; all passed in this run. Hash-based difference implementation was read.

expectations.text: Execution-permission changes that affect the user are detected.
expectations.evidence: Synthetic probe.sh mode 0755 to 0655 changes direct execution from status 0 to EACCES, while reviewer returns exit 0, status unmodified, and empty local_changes. review-update.mjs:44 stores only Boolean(mode & 0o111).

expectations.text: Empty directories and prototype-like filenames are detected as local changes.
expectations.evidence: Test 13 creates __proto__, constructor, toString and empty-local/ and asserts the exact added array. It passed; inventory uses Object.create(null) and records directory entries.

expectations.text: Invalid package paths and unsupported package inputs do not produce green review.
expectations.evidence: Independent CLI missing-path probe returned exit 1 with unverified/ENOENT and empty stdout; wrong argument count returned exit 1. Existing test 14 exercised root/interior symlinks, absent SKILL.md, oversized file and excessive entries and passed.

expectations.text: The real pinned installer is actually killed with SIGKILL and injection is restricted to exact synthetic targets.
expectations.evidence: Read the installed skills 1.5.24 CLI cleanup/copy code and hook. Tests call its real executable, compare signal to SIGKILL and marker copied-SKILL-before-termination, with destination built from each fresh mkdtemp project. Hook matches target plus separator and kills only process.pid. Four actual interruption cases passed.

expectations.text: Failed staged installation leaves live installation unchanged.
expectations.evidence: Tests 16 and 18 run interrupted installers in separate failed staging projects and assert live inventory equals its pre-run snapshot. Both passed.

expectations.text: Backups and rollback actually preserve previous bytes and unrelated files.
expectations.evidence: Tests 15/17 restore a real backup including local-only.txt after confirmed partial reinstallation. Tests 16/18 use differing older instruction bytes, assert candidate change, preserve backup identity, roll back with rename, compare restored inventory and unrelated.txt. All passed.

expectations.text: Documentation does not claim atomic exchange, automatic lock merging or verified host reload.
expectations.evidence: UPGRADING.md:66 explicitly disclaims lock-file merger; :69 distinguishes filesystem tests from host behavior; :71-74 says two moves are not atomic and disclaims concurrent-editor/power-loss guarantees; :103-104 preserves untested boundaries.

findings.title: Owner execute-bit loss is silently reported as unmodified
findings.recommendation: Preserve the exact owner/group/other execute mask instead of collapsing it to Boolean; explicitly define whether full POSIX mode tracking is intended and add behavior-based permission regressions.

claims.claim: The utility compares executable bits and exit 0 means installed matches baseline.
claims.evidence: Owner execute-bit loss is not represented, even though direct execution fails.

claims.claim: Controlled installer interruption can leave a partial package and staging avoids changing live bytes.
claims.evidence: Real installer subprocess signal and marker assertions, package comparisons, and unchanged live assertions passed in both directory layouts.

claims.claim: Backups restore old bytes without implying atomic replacement or host reload proof.
claims.evidence: Distinct old/candidate byte snapshots were compared after replacement and rollback; documented limitations are explicit.

suggestions.assertion: review detects removed files and executable-bit changes
suggestions.reason: The test only toggles between 0644 and 0755, so it passes even when different owner/group/other execution permissions collapse to the same Boolean. Add 0755 to 0655 and inspect both review status and actual executable behavior.

eval_feedback.overall: Most assertions inspect real observable state. The permission assertion misses a user-visible false-green counterexample.

limitations: This review covers ordinary trusted quiescent local packages, not adversarial concurrent filesystem mutation.
Existing test-owned temporary directories were cleaned by test hooks; the separate permission counterexample is retained.
No external models, host reload, lock-file merge, remote download interruption or power-loss test was performed.
